  Widget _buildEmptyState(AppLocalizations l10n) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(

  Widget _buildFilterTab({

          border: isSelected ? Border.all(color: context.borderAdaptive) : null,
          boxShadow: isSelected && !context.isDarkMode
              ? [
                  BoxShadow(
                      color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.05),
                      blurRadius: 4,
                      offset: const Offset(0, 1))
                ]
              : null,
        ),

  Widget _buildNotificationItem(AppNotification item, AppLocalizations l10n) {
    final isFamily = item.category == 'family' || item.type == 'family';
    final isGuest = item.category == 'guest' || item.type == 'guest';
    final isDanger = item.category == 'risk' ||
        item.category == 'fall' ||
        item.type == 'danger' ||
        item.type == 'fall' ||
        item.category == 'stranger';
    final hasCameraPlayback =
        item.cameraId.isNotEmpty || item.body.toLowerCase().contains('camera');
    final relativeTime = _formatRelativeTime(item.createdAt, l10n);

    Color categoryColor;
    Color categoryBg;
    IconData categoryIcon;

    if (isFamily) {
      categoryColor = const Color(0xFF10B981);
      categoryBg = const Color(0x2610B981);
      categoryIcon = Icons.verified_user_rounded;
    } else if (isGuest) {
      categoryColor = const Color(0xFF38BDF8);
      categoryBg = const Color(0x2638BDF8);
      categoryIcon = Icons.handshake_outlined;
    } else if (isDanger) {
      categoryColor = HubSightColors.error;
      categoryBg = HubSightColors.errorBg;
      categoryIcon = Icons.warning_amber_rounded;
    } else {
      categoryColor = HubSightColors.primary;
      categoryBg = HubSightColors.primaryBg;
      categoryIcon = Icons.notifications_none_rounded;
    }

    return Dismissible(
      key: Key(item.id),
      direction: DismissDirection.endToStart,
      confirmDismiss: (_) => _deleteNotificationFromServer(item.id),
      onDismissed: (_) => _removeNotificationLocally(item),
      background: Container(
        alignment: Alignment.centerRight,
        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 20),
        color: HubSightColors.errorBg,
        child: const Icon(Icons.delete_outline,
            color: HubSightColors.errorText, size: 24),
      ),
      child: InkWell(
        onTap: () => _handleItemClick(item),
        child: Container(
          color: !item.isRead
              ? context.surfaceAdaptive.withValues(alpha: 0.5)
              : Colors.transparent,
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 16, vertical: 14),
          child: Row(
            crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
            children: [
              // Leading category icon badge
              Container(
                width: 38,
                height: 38,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  color: categoryBg,
                  borderRadius: HubSightRadius.roundedXl,
                  border:
                      Border.all(color: categoryColor.withValues(alpha: 0.3)),
                ),
                child: Icon(categoryIcon, color: categoryColor, size: 20),
              ),
              const SizedBox(width: 12),

              // Content Area
              Expanded(
                child: Column(
                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                  children: [
                    // Title & Time Row
                    Row(
                      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.center,
                      children: [
                        if (!item.isRead) ...[
                          Container(
                            width: 6,
                            height: 6,
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 6),
                            decoration: BoxDecoration(
                              color: categoryColor,
                              shape: BoxShape.circle,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                        Expanded(
                          child: Text(
                            item.title,
                            style: TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 13.5,
                              fontWeight: !item.isRead
                                  ? FontWeight.bold
                                  : FontWeight.w600,
                              color: context.textPrimaryAdaptive,
                            ),
                            maxLines: 1,
                            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                          ),
                        ),
                        const SizedBox(width: 6),
                        Text(
                          relativeTime,
                          style: TextStyle(
                            fontSize: 11,
                            fontWeight: !item.isRead
                                ? FontWeight.bold
                                : FontWeight.normal,
                            color: !item.isRead
                                ? categoryColor
                                : context.textMutedAdaptive,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 4),

                    // Body Description
                    Text(
                      item.body,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 12,
                        color: context.textSecondaryAdaptive,
                        height: 1.35,
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Action Link (Xem lại camera)
                    if (hasCameraPlayback) ...[
                      const SizedBox(height: 8),
                      Row(
                        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
                        children: [
                          const Icon(Icons.videocam_outlined,
                              size: 14, color: HubSightColors.primary),
                          const SizedBox(width: 4),
                          Text(
                            l10n.viewPlayback,
                            style: const TextStyle(
                              fontSize: 11.5,
                              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              color: HubSightColors.primary,
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ],
                  ],
                ),
              ),

              // Delete action icon
              IconButton(
                icon: Icon(Icons.close_rounded,
                    size: 16, color: context.textMutedAdaptive),
                onPressed: () async {
                  final deleted = await _deleteNotificationFromServer(item.id);
                  if (deleted) _removeNotificationLocally(item);
                },
                visualDensity: VisualDensity.compact,
                padding: EdgeInsets.zero,
                constraints: const BoxConstraints(),
              ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

    required int currentIndex,
    required int unreadCount,
    required AppLocalizations l10n,
  }) {
    final dockGradient = context.isDarkMode
        ? [
            HubSightColors.surfaceDark.withValues(alpha: 0.96),
            HubSightColors.cardDark.withValues(alpha: 0.94),
          ]

            Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.97),

      child: DecoratedBox(
        decoration: BoxDecoration(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
          boxShadow: [
            BoxShadow(
              color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.50 : 0.12),
              blurRadius: 28,
              spreadRadius: -8,
              offset: const Offset(0, 10),
            ),
            BoxShadow(
              color: HubSightColors.primary.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.10 : 0.07),
              blurRadius: 24,
              spreadRadius: -10,
              offset: const Offset(0, 5),
            ),
          ],
        ),
        child: ClipRRect(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
          child: BackdropFilter(
            filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 18, sigmaY: 18),
            child: Container(
              key: const Key('main-navigation-dock'),
              height: 66,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(6),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                gradient: LinearGradient(
                  begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                  end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                  colors: dockGradient,
                ),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(26),
                border: Border.all(
                  color: context.isDarkMode
                      ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.10)
                      : HubSightColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
                ),
              ),
              child: Row(
                children: [
                  _buildTabItem(
                    index: 0,
                    currentIndex: currentIndex,
                    label: l10n.tabPlayback,
                    activeIcon: Icons.videocam_rounded,
                    inactiveIcon: Icons.videocam_outlined,
                  ),
                  _buildTabItem(
                    index: 1,
                    currentIndex: currentIndex,
                    label: l10n.tabDashboard,
                    activeIcon: Icons.grid_view_rounded,
                    inactiveIcon: Icons.grid_view_outlined,

                  _buildTabItem(
                    index: 2,

                  _buildTabItem(
                    index: 3,

                    activeIcon: Icons.tune_rounded,
                    inactiveIcon: Icons.tune_outlined,
                  ),
                ],
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTabItem({
    required int index,
    required int currentIndex,
    required String label,
    required IconData activeIcon,
    required IconData inactiveIcon,
    int badgeCount = 0,
  }) {
    final isSelected = index == currentIndex;

    return Expanded(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 2),
        child: Semantics(
          button: true,
          selected: isSelected,
          label: label,
          child: Material(
            color: Colors.transparent,
            child: InkWell(
              key: Key('main-navigation-tab-$index'),
              onTap: () {
                if (!isSelected) {
                  HapticFeedback.selectionClick();
                  ref.read(mainTabIndexProvider.notifier).state = index;
                }
              },
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
              splashColor: isSelected
                  ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.14)
                  : HubSightColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
              highlightColor: isSelected
                  ? Colors.white.withValues(alpha: 0.08)
                  : HubSightColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.06),
              child: AnimatedContainer(
                duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 320),
                curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                height: 54,
                decoration: BoxDecoration(
                  gradient: isSelected
                      ? const LinearGradient(
                          begin: Alignment.topLeft,
                          end: Alignment.bottomRight,
                          colors: [HubSightColors.primaryLight, HubSightColors.primary],
                        )
                      : null,
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
                  boxShadow: isSelected
                      ? [
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: HubSightColors.primary.withValues(alpha: 0.30),
                            blurRadius: 14,
                            spreadRadius: -4,
                            offset: const Offset(0, 5),
                          ),
                          BoxShadow(
                            color: Colors.white.withValues(alpha: context.isDarkMode ? 0.10 : 0.24),
                            blurRadius: 1,
                            offset: const Offset(0, 1),
                          ),
                        ]
                      : null,
                ),
                child: Column(
                  mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
                  children: [
                    Stack(
                      clipBehavior: Clip.none,
                      children: [
                        AnimatedSwitcher(
                          duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
                          switchInCurve: Curves.easeOutBack,
                          switchOutCurve: Curves.easeIn,
                          transitionBuilder: (child, animation) => FadeTransition(
                            opacity: animation,
                            child: ScaleTransition(scale: animation, child: child),
                          ),
                          child: Icon(
                            isSelected ? activeIcon : inactiveIcon,
                            key: ValueKey(isSelected),
                            size: isSelected ? 23 : 22,
                            color: isSelected ? Colors.white : context.textMutedAdaptive,
                          ),
                        ),
                        if (badgeCount > 0)
                          Positioned(
                            top: -7,
                            right: -12,
                            child: Container(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 4.5, vertical: 1),
                              constraints: const BoxConstraints(minWidth: 17, minHeight: 17),
                              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                                color: isSelected ? Colors.white : HubSightColors.error,
                                borderRadius: HubSightRadius.roundedFull,
                                border: Border.all(
                                  color: isSelected
                                      ? HubSightColors.primaryLight
                                      : context.cardAdaptive,
                                  width: 1.5,
                                ),
                                boxShadow: [
                                  BoxShadow(
                                    color: Colors.black.withValues(alpha: 0.14),
                                    blurRadius: 5,
                                    offset: const Offset(0, 2),
                                  ),
                                ],
                              ),
                              child: Text(
                                badgeCount > 99 ? '99+' : '$badgeCount',
                                style: TextStyle(
                                  color: isSelected ? HubSightColors.error : Colors.white,
                                  fontSize: 9.5,
                                  fontWeight: FontWeight.w800,
                                  height: 1.1,
                                ),
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                      ],
                    ),
                    const SizedBox(height: 3),
                    AnimatedDefaultTextStyle(
                      duration: const Duration(milliseconds: 240),
                      curve: Curves.easeOutCubic,
                      style: TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 10.5,
                        fontWeight: isSelected ? FontWeight.w700 : FontWeight.w600,
                        color: isSelected ? Colors.white : context.textMutedAdaptive,
                        letterSpacing: isSelected ? -0.15 : -0.05,
                        height: 1,
                      ),
                      child: Text(
                        label,
                        maxLines: 1,
                        overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }"""

replacements = [
    (old_import, new_import),
    (old_bar, new_bar),
    (old_method, new_method),
]

for old, new in replacements:
    count = text.count(old)
    if count != 1:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Expected exactly one match, found {count}: {old[:100]!r}")
    text = text.replace(old, new, 1)

path.write_text(text)

class AppThemeModeNotifier extends StateNotifier<ThemeMode> {
  final StorageService _storage;
  final Ref _ref;

  AppThemeModeNotifier(this._storage, this._ref)
      : super(_parseThemeMode(_storage.getThemeMode()));

  static ThemeMode _parseThemeMode(String? val) {
    if (val == 'light') return ThemeMode.light;
    if (val == 'dark') return ThemeMode.dark;
    return ThemeMode.system;
  }

  static String modeToString(ThemeMode mode) {
    switch (mode) {
      case ThemeMode.light:
        return 'light';
      case ThemeMode.dark:
        return 'dark';
      case ThemeMode.system:
        return 'system';
    }

Đã redesign bottom navigation theo phong cách hiện đại 2026 tại `lib/features/common/main_tab_screen.dart:92`.

### Thiết kế mới

- **Floating navigation dock** bo tròn, tách khỏi cạnh màn hình.
- Hiệu ứng **frosted glass** với `BackdropFilter`.
- Nền gradient thích ứng riêng cho **dark mode/light mode**.
- Tab đang chọn sử dụng gradient cam thương hiệu HubSight.
- Animation chuyển icon bằng fade + scale với easing mềm.
- Shadow nhiều lớp tạo chiều sâu nhưng không quá nặng.
- Badge thông báo được thiết kế lại:
    - Màu đỏ khi chưa chọn.
    - Nền trắng, chữ đỏ khi tab đang active.
    - Hỗ trợ hiển thị `99+`.
- Tăng độ tương phản của tab chưa chọn trong dark mode.
- Giữ đầy đủ nhãn của cả 4 tab và bổ sung `Semantics` cho accessibility.
- Không thay đổi logic `IndexedStack`, trạng thái tab hoặc notification badge.

- App đang chạy với PID `98486`.

### Vì sao chọn vuông bo góc?

- Phù hợp ngôn ngữ thiết kế camera, dashboard và các card của HubSight.
- Phân biệt rõ **navigation destination** với nút hành động tròn/FAB.
- Icon không còn nằm trong một khối bị kéo dẹt theo chiều ngang.

- Active icon nằm trong ô cố định `34 × 34px`.
- Bo góc `12px`.
- Gradient cam và shadow chỉ áp dụng quanh icon.
- Label active dùng màu cam thương hiệu thay vì nằm trong nền cam.
- Toàn bộ vùng tab vẫn là vùng nhấn lớn `54px`, nên không ảnh hưởng usability.
- Badge notification vẫn bám đúng vào góc icon.
- Floating dock và khoảng cách với mép dưới được giữ nguyên.

- Kiểm tra trực quan trên **light mode**: tỷ lệ cân đối, label không tràn.
- `flutter test test/main_tab_screen_test.dart`: **3/3 passed**

from pathlib import Path

path = Path("lib/features/common/main_tab_screen.dart")
text = path.read_text()

text = text.replace("import 'dart:ui';\n", "", 1)

old_scaffold = """    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.bgAdaptive,
      body: IndexedStack("""
new_scaffold = """    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: context.bgAdaptive,
      extendBody: true,
      body: IndexedStack("""
if text.count(old_scaffold) != 1:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not locate main Scaffold")
text = text.replace(old_scaffold, new_scaffold, 1)

start = text.index("  Widget _buildNavigationDock({")
end = text.index("  Widget _buildTabItem({", start)
if start < 0 or end <= start:
    raise RuntimeError("Could not locate navigation dock method")

dock_method = """  Widget _buildNavigationDock({
    required int currentIndex,
    required int unreadCount,
    required AppLocalizations l10n,
  }) {
    final bottomSpacing = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom + 10;

    return SafeArea(
      top: false,
      minimum: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(12, 8, 12, bottomSpacing),
      child: SizedBox(
        key: const Key('main-navigation-dock'),
        height: 66,
        child: Row(
          children: [
            _buildTabItem(
              index: 0,
              currentIndex: currentIndex,
              label: l10n.tabPlayback,
              activeIcon: Icons.videocam_rounded,
              inactiveIcon: Icons.videocam_outlined,
            ),
            _buildTabItem(
              index: 1,
              currentIndex: currentIndex,
              label: l10n.tabDashboard,
              activeIcon: Icons.grid_view_rounded,
              inactiveIcon: Icons.grid_view_outlined,
            ),
            _buildTabItem(
              index: 2,
              currentIndex: currentIndex,
              label: l10n.tabNotifications,
              activeIcon: Icons.notifications_rounded,
              inactiveIcon: Icons.notifications_none_rounded,
              badgeCount: unreadCount,
            ),
            _buildTabItem(
              index: 3,
              currentIndex: currentIndex,
              label: l10n.tabSettings,
              activeIcon: Icons.tune_rounded,
              inactiveIcon: Icons.tune_outlined,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

"""

path.write_text(text[:start] + dock_method + text[end:])

## Current implementation

SDK is locked to `hubsight_sdk 1.2.0` in `pubspec.lock`; enrollment is coordinated by `SdkStateNotifier` in `lib/core/network/sdk_provider.dart`.

### QR flow

1. `MobileScannerController` accepts QR codes only; the first detected barcode is used. Repeated scans are suppressed while `_isProcessingQr` is true (`lib/features/config/server_config_screen.dart:47`, `:65`).
2. The user can alternatively select an image. `FilePicker` returns a path, then `MobileScannerController.analyzeImage` extracts the first QR (`:75`).
3. Raw text is trimmed and parsed with `HubSightQRPayload.fromString` (`:99`).
    - SDK payload fields are `version`, `configId`, `name`, `downloadUrl`, and `sha256`.
    - Parsing only requires a JSON object with compatible field types. Missing fields default to empty strings/version 1.
4. A bottom sheet immediately shows the QR-declared name or ID and the config ID, then requests a PIN (`:118–253`).
5. On confirmation:
    - PIN gets app-level validation.
    - The encrypted container is downloaded into memory with Dio from the QR-provided URL.
    - Connect timeout is 15 seconds; receive timeout is 30 seconds.
    - If QR `sha256` is nonempty, SHA-256 of the downloaded encrypted bytes is checked.
    - The bytes and PIN go to `SdkStateNotifier.enrollFromHscfg`.
6. `enrollFromHscfg` disposes the current SDK, invokes `HubSightSDK.fromHscfg`, installs the returned SDK in Riverpod, binds event streams, and starts lifecycle handling (`lib/core/network/sdk_provider.dart:85–103`).
7. Successful enrollment navigates according to `isInitialSetup`.

Notable behavior:

- Scanner detection continues behind the bottom sheet; `_isProcessingQr` merely ignores detections.
- The sheet remains swipe/barrier-dismissible while download/decryption is running.
- Every retry downloads the file again.
- QR payload metadata is untrusted and is displayed before checksum/decryption.
- There is no QR version, URL scheme/host, nonempty ID, checksum-format, response-size, or content-type validation.

### File flow

1. `FilePicker` uses `FileType.any` with `withData: true` (`server_config_screen.dart:452`).
2. If bytes are available, the entire file and its filename are retained in widget state.
3. The UI marks any selected byte buffer as a successful selection; it does not require a `.hscfg` extension or inspect the header (`:789–826`).
4. The user enters a PIN and presses the enrollment button.
5. After file/PIN checks, the same `SdkStateNotifier.enrollFromHscfg` path decrypts, persists, initializes, and activates the SDK (`:474–507`).
6. There is no preview, outer checksum, connectivity check, or confirmation step.

During enrollment, only the action button is disabled. The PIN field and file picker remain interactive, and selected bytes/PIN remain in memory after errors.

## Validation, checksum, PIN, and cryptographic behavior

### PIN

Both UI flows use:

```dart
pin.length == 6 && int.tryParse(pin) != null
```

after trimming.

Implications:

- Leading-zero PINs work.
- This is not strict six-digit validation; six-character signed values such as `+12345` or `-12345` can pass `int.tryParse`.
- `keyboardType: TextInputType.number` is only a keyboard hint; there is no digits-only input formatter.
- There is no retry throttling.

SDK `HscfgDecoder.decrypt` trims the PIN but itself checks only length 6—not numeric content. Direct SDK callers can therefore use any six-character PIN.

### Container validation

`HscfgDecoder.decrypt` is publicly exported by SDK 1.2.0 and performs:

- Minimum 50-byte size check.
- Exact six-byte `HSCFG\x01` magic-header check.
- Argon2id key derivation: 64 MB memory, 4 iterations, parallelism 2.
- AES-256-GCM authenticated decryption.
- Production 32-byte salt attempt, then 16-byte fixture fallback.
- In-memory ZIP decompression.
- Required presence of `urls.yml` and `key.yml`.
- YAML parsing, plus optional `metadata.yml`, Firebase files, and CA certificate.
- Optional Ed25519 verification.

Wrong PIN and tampered encrypted content converge on `configDecryptionFailed`. The decoder verifies file presence, but does not require endpoint/key fields to be nonempty. `HubSightAppConfig.apiKey` can ultimately fall back to `hs_mob_client_default`.

### Integrity and authenticity

- QR `sha256` covers the downloaded encrypted `.hscfg` bytes, but is optional.
- Since URL and checksum come from the same QR, the checksum protects against accidental/network corruption, not necessarily a malicious QR.
- Local-file enrollment has no outer checksum, but AES-GCM authenticates encrypted content if the correct PIN is used.
- Metadata `contentSha256` is parsed but not validated by SDK 1.2.0.
- Ed25519 verification only runs when both a public key and signature are present; unsigned containers are accepted even with `verifySignature: true`.
- The public key is carried inside the same container, so verification alone does not establish provenance without an external trust anchor.
- SDK verification signs/checks the entire decrypted ZIP while reading the signature from metadata inside that ZIP. That appears circular for normal package generation; compatibility with the backend producer should be confirmed before relying on signature-bearing packages.

### Error presentation

`AppErrorLocalizer` intentionally hides developer messages. Most malformed, corrupted, decryption, and decompression cases collapse to the same “decryption failed” localization (`lib/core/localization/error_localizer.dart:19–25`).

Consequently, the QR checksum mismatch is thrown as `configCorrupted` with a checksum-specific developer message, but the user receives the generic decryption-failure message rather than `scanQrChecksumMismatch`.

Non-SDK Dio/general exceptions also become the generic app error. In contrast, image/file picker exceptions interpolate raw exception text into hard-coded Vietnamese messages.

## Data available for a pre-enrollment summary

### Before PIN/decryption

From QR:

- QR-declared version.
- Config ID.
- Display name.
- Download URL.
- Expected SHA-256.
- After download: byte size and actual SHA-256/checksum result.
- Basic container header validity.

The current sheet displays only name/fallback ID and config ID.

From a selected file:

- Filename.
- Byte size.
- Locally computed SHA-256.
- Whether the magic header and minimum size look valid.

Because `.hscfg` contents are encrypted, endpoints, server metadata, and client identity are not available from a local file before PIN decryption.

### After PIN, still without saving

SDK 1.2.0 supports the required separation:

```dart
final config = await HscfgDecoder.decrypt(
  fileBytes: bytes,
  pin6Digits: pin,
);
```

`HscfgDecoder.decrypt` has no secure-storage or SDK-state side effects. It returns a `HubSightAppConfig` containing:

- **Metadata:** format version, config ID, name, description, creator, creation time, generator/issuer, declared content hash, signature algorithm, signature/public-key presence.
- **Endpoints:** gateway, API base, relay WebSocket, WebRTC base/signaling URL, media port.
- **Client identity:** client ID, client name, allowed scopes.
- **Secrets:** client secret and API key.
- **Optional payloads:** Firebase Android/iOS configuration and CA certificate.

A safe review UI can show metadata, endpoint hosts/URLs, port, client name/partially masked ID, scopes, and presence of CA/Firebase/signature material. It should not expose the client secret, API key, raw Firebase contents, certificate contents, or sensitive query parameters in a download URL.

After explicit confirmation, the already-decoded config can be activated with:

```dart
ref
  .read(hubsightSdkProvider.notifier)
  .initializeFromConfig(config);
```

This avoids calling `fromHscfg` during preview and avoids a second expensive Argon2/decryption pass. For QR, retain the exact verified downloaded bytes/config through confirmation rather than re-downloading, which would introduce a time-of-check/time-of-use gap.

The decoded package does **not** prove server reachability or credentials validity. `HubSightSDK.initialize` saves config and constructs clients without probing the server.

## Persistence and navigation

`HubSightSDK.fromHscfg` performs decryption and then calls `HubSightSDK.initialize`. `initialize` saves config to secure storage before constructing and returning the SDK. Thus the current enrollment call is inherently both “inspect” and “commit”; it must not be used for a pre-enrollment summary.

Secure storage persists URLs, client-key data, and metadata in three separate writes. It does not persist the optional Firebase files or CA certificate, so those are lost after restoration/restart.

On success (`server_config_screen.dart:510–523`):

- `isInitialSetup == true`: `pushReplacement` to a new `LoginScreen`.
- `isInitialSetup == false`: pop the screen and attempt to show a success SnackBar.

Startup itself restores saved config; if none exists, it creates and saves a built-in default server configuration and then shows Login (`lib/main.dart:63–115`, `:191–206`). Therefore configuration is not normally the app’s first screen.

Entry paths:

- Login fallback with no restorable SDK pushes `ServerConfigScreen()`—defaulting to initial setup.
- Login’s server selector opens it with `isInitialSetup: false` (`lib/features/auth/login_screen.dart:604–613`).
- Settings also uses `isInitialSetup: false` (`lib/features/settings/settings_screen.dart:1451–1459`).

The initial fallback path can create a `[Login, Config, Login]` stack: Login pushes Config, then Config replaces itself with another Login. Non-initial success also relies on a now-popping route context to locate `ScaffoldMessenger`, which is workable in many cases but brittle under navigation refactors.

## Existing test constraints

`test/server_config_screen_test.dart` contains one widget test. It:

- Uses `ProviderScope` without SDK overrides.
- Uses Vietnamese localization explicitly.
- Requires a `TabBar` and exactly two `Tab` widgets.
- Requires exact visible strings:
    - `Quét mã QR`
    - `Tệp cấu hình (.hscfg)`
    - `Chọn ảnh QR từ thư viện`
    - `Chọn tệp .hscfg`
    - `MÃ PIN BẢO MẬT (6 SỐ)`
    - `Giải mã & Kết nối`
- Taps the file tab and uses `pumpAndSettle`.

It does **not** cover:

- QR payload parsing or camera callbacks.
- QR image/file picker platform APIs.
- PIN edge cases.
- Download behavior/timeouts.
- Checksum success/failure.
- HSCFG decryption or signatures.
- Provider cleanup/persistence.
- Error localization.
- Bottom-sheet dismissal races.
- Success navigation or active-server replacement.

Because scanner, Dio, file picker, and static SDK APIs are instantiated directly inside the private widget state, deeper tests will require platform mocks or dependency extraction/injection.

Validation run:

```text
flutter test test/server_config_screen_test.dart
00:02 +1: All tests passed!
```

## Concrete refactor risks

1. **Do not use `enrollFromHscfg` for preview.** It disposes the active SDK before decryption and saves the new config on success.
2. **Failed reconfiguration currently destroys active in-memory state.** `_cleanupCurrent()` runs before decrypting; a wrong PIN or malformed file leaves Riverpod SDK state null, although the old persisted config remains.
3. **Commit is not transactional.** Config is written before SDK construction, in three independent secure-storage writes, with no rollback or server check.
4. **Existing auth tokens are not cleared when changing servers.** Old access/refresh tokens can survive under a new endpoint configuration.
5. **Avoid decrypting twice.** Argon2 uses 64 MB and four iterations; preview should retain the decoded config until confirmation.
6. **Protect secrets held by the summary state.** `HubSightAppConfig` includes client secret/API key and optional service files. Minimize lifetime and clear references/PIN on cancellation; Dart cannot guarantee secure memory zeroization.
7. **Preserve exact source bytes across QR review.** Re-downloading at confirmation weakens checksum/summary guarantees.
8. **Add semantic validation separately.** SDK decryption success does not imply supported QR version, trusted HTTPS/WSS endpoints, nonempty IDs/URLs/keys, or reachable server.
9. **Resolve modal cancellation races.** The QR sheet can be dismissed during async work, after which `setModalState` may target a disposed sheet while enrollment/download continues.
10. **Unify duplicated flow logic carefully.** QR and file share PIN validation/decryption/activation but differ in acquisition and checksum. Over-unifying can accidentally omit QR checksum verification or add an impossible pre-PIN file summary.
11. **Do not present “signature verified” without qualification.** Unsigned files pass, the key is self-contained, and the SDK’s signed-byte convention needs confirmation.
12. **Preserve current widget-test contracts or update the test deliberately.** Changing two `Tab` widgets, Vietnamese labels, or initial QR/file-tab visibility will break the only existing test even if behavior improves.

No files were edited.

- Nhánh **file**: chọn file → nhập PIN → giải mã → summary.
- Nhánh **QR**: scan → tải và kiểm checksum → hiển thị summary metadata QR → khi người dùng xác nhận, nếu container yêu cầu PIN thì wizard mở bước PIN ngay trong luồng QR trước khi commit.
- Chỉ sau màn hình summary cuối và nút đồng ý mới gọi `initializeFromConfig`, nên config cũ không bị mất nếu người dùng huỷ hoặc nhập sai PIN.

Tiếp theo mình sẽ xác nhận model config để thiết kế summary an toàn, không lộ API key/client secret.

/// Models representing HubSight decrypted configuration package (.hscfg).
class HubSightUrls {
  final String gatewayUrl;
  final String apiBaseUrl;
  final String relayWsUrl;
  final String webrtcBaseUrl;
  final String webrtcSignalingUrl;
  final int webrtcMediaPort;

  const HubSightUrls({
    required this.gatewayUrl,
    required this.apiBaseUrl,
    required this.relayWsUrl,
    required this.webrtcBaseUrl,
    this.webrtcSignalingUrl = '',
    this.webrtcMediaPort = 8555,
  });

  factory HubSightUrls.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    final gw = (map['gateway_url'] as String? ?? '').trim();
    final signaling = (map['webrtc_signaling_url'] as String? ?? '').trim();
    return HubSightUrls(
      gatewayUrl: gw,
      apiBaseUrl: (map['api_base_url'] as String? ?? '').trim(),
      relayWsUrl: (map['relay_ws_url'] as String? ?? '').trim(),
      webrtcBaseUrl: (map['webrtc_base_url'] as String? ?? '').trim(),
      webrtcSignalingUrl: signaling.isNotEmpty
          ? signaling
          : (gw.isNotEmpty ? '$gw/webrtc' : ''),
      webrtcMediaPort: map['webrtc_media_port'] is int
          ? map['webrtc_media_port'] as int
          : int.tryParse(map['webrtc_media_port']?.toString() ?? '') ?? 8555,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'gateway_url': gatewayUrl,
      'api_base_url': apiBaseUrl,
      'relay_ws_url': relayWsUrl,
      'webrtc_base_url': webrtcBaseUrl,
      'webrtc_signaling_url': webrtcSignalingUrl,
      'webrtc_media_port': webrtcMediaPort,
    };
  }
}

class HubSightClientKey {
  final String clientId;
  final String clientSecret;
  final String clientName;
  final String apiKey;
  final List<String> allowedScopes;

  const HubSightClientKey({
    required this.clientId,
    required this.clientSecret,
    required this.clientName,
    this.apiKey = '',
    this.allowedScopes = const [],
  });

  factory HubSightClientKey.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    final scopesRaw = map['allowed_scopes'];
    List<String> scopes = [];
    if (scopesRaw is List) {
      scopes = scopesRaw.map((e) => e.toString()).toList();
    }
    final apiKeyVal = (map['api_key'] as String? ?? '').trim();
    final clientSecretVal = (map['client_secret'] as String? ?? '').trim();
    return HubSightClientKey(
      clientId: (map['client_id'] as String? ?? '').trim(),
      clientSecret: clientSecretVal,
      clientName: (map['client_name'] as String? ?? '').trim(),
      apiKey: apiKeyVal,
      allowedScopes: scopes,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'client_id': clientId,
      'client_secret': clientSecret,
      'client_name': clientName,
      'api_key': apiKey,
      'allowed_scopes': allowedScopes,
    };
  }
}

class HubSightConfigMetadata {
  final String formatVersion;
  final String configId;
  final String name;
  final String description;
  final String createdBy;
  final String? createdAtUtc;
  final String? generator;
  final String? ed25519PublicKey;
  final String? signature;
  final String? contentSha256;
  final String? signatureAlgorithm;

  const HubSightConfigMetadata({
    required this.formatVersion,
    required this.configId,
    required this.name,
    this.description = '',
    this.createdBy = '',
    this.createdAtUtc,
    this.generator,
    this.ed25519PublicKey,
    this.signature,
    this.contentSha256,
    this.signatureAlgorithm,
  });

  factory HubSightConfigMetadata.fromMap(Map<String, dynamic> map) {
    return HubSightConfigMetadata(
      formatVersion:
          (map['format_version'] ?? map['version'] ?? '1.0').toString(),
      configId: (map['config_id'] ?? '').toString(),
      name: (map['name'] ?? map['config_name'] ?? '').toString(),
      description: (map['description'] ?? '').toString(),
      createdBy:
          (map['created_by'] ?? map['created_by_username'] ?? '').toString(),
      createdAtUtc: (map['created_at_utc'] ?? map['created_at'])?.toString(),
      generator: (map['generator'] ?? map['issuer'])?.toString(),
      ed25519PublicKey:
          (map['ed25519_public_key'] ?? map['public_key'])?.toString(),
      signature: (map['signature'] ?? map['digital_signature'])?.toString(),
      contentSha256: map['content_sha256']?.toString(),
      signatureAlgorithm: map['signature_algorithm']?.toString(),
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toMap() {
    return {
      'format_version': formatVersion,
      'config_id': configId,
      'name': name,
      'description': description,
      'created_by': createdBy,
      'created_at_utc': createdAtUtc,
      'generator': generator,
      'ed25519_public_key': ed25519PublicKey,
      'signature': signature,
      if (contentSha256 != null) 'content_sha256': contentSha256,
      if (signatureAlgorithm != null) 'signature_algorithm': signatureAlgorithm,
    };
  }
}

import 'dart:convert';

/// Representation of QR code data scanned by the app.
class HubSightQRPayload {
  final int version;
  final String configId;
  final String name;
  final String downloadUrl;
  final String sha256;

  const HubSightQRPayload({
    required this.version,
    required this.configId,
    required this.name,
    required this.downloadUrl,
    required this.sha256,
  });

  factory HubSightQRPayload.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic> json) {
    return HubSightQRPayload(
      version: json['v'] as int? ?? 1,
      configId: json['config_id'] as String? ?? '',
      name: json['name'] as String? ?? '',
      downloadUrl: json['download_url'] as String? ?? '',
      sha256: json['sha256'] as String? ?? '',
    );
  }

  factory HubSightQRPayload.fromString(String raw) {
    final decoded = jsonDecode(raw);
    if (decoded is! Map<String, dynamic>) {
      throw const FormatException('QR code data must be a valid JSON object');
    }
    return HubSightQRPayload.fromJson(decoded);
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> toJson() {
    return {
      'v': version,
      'config_id': configId,
      'name': name,
      'download_url': downloadUrl,
      'sha256': sha256,
    };
  }

    HubSightSecureStorage? storage,
    DeviceInfoCollector? deviceCollector,
    void Function(MaintenanceException)? onMaintenance,
    void Function()? onSessionExpired,
  }) async {
    final config = await HscfgDecoder.decrypt(

      pin6Digits: pin6Digits,

    return initialize(

      storage: storage,
      deviceCollector: deviceCollector,
      onMaintenance: onMaintenance,
      onSessionExpired: onSessionExpired,
    );

  Future<void> _handleLogout() async {
    final sdk = ref.read(hubsightSdkProvider);
    final fcm = ref.read(fcmServiceProvider);

    if (sdk != null) {
      final token = fcm.fcmToken;
      if (token != null) {
        try {
          await sdk.fcm.unregisterPushToken(token);
        } catch (_) {}
      }

## Assistant

<thinking>
**Assessing implementation feasibility without Firebase config**

**Diagnosing missing push notification entitlements and Firebase setup**

**Summarizing implementation gaps and next step requirements**
</thinking>

Đúng — chức năng push notification **mới được viết phần khung, chưa được cấu hình hoàn chỉnh**, nên bản app hiện tại không thể xin quyền hoặc nhận push notification từ iOS.

### Những phần đã có

- Dependency `firebase_core` và `firebase_messaging`.
- `FcmService` có:
    - `requestPermission()`
    - lấy FCM token
    - đăng ký token với backend
    - xử lý foreground/background notification.
- Sau khi login có logic đồng bộ token với HubSight SDK.

### Những phần đang thiếu hoặc sai

1. **Không có `GoogleService-Info.plist`**
    - Project không chứa file cấu hình Firebase cho iOS.
    - Cũng không có `google-services.json` cho Android.
    - Vì vậy `Firebase.initializeApp()` thất bại trước khi chạy đến `requestPermission()`.

2. **iOS chưa bật Push Notifications capability**
    - Không có file `Runner.entitlements`.
    - Xcode project không có `CODE_SIGN_ENTITLEMENTS`.
    - Binary vừa cài không có entitlement `aps-environment`.
    - Vì vậy iOS không xem HubSight là ứng dụng hỗ trợ thông báo và chưa hiển thị ứng dụng trong phần Notifications của Settings.

3. **FCM initialization không được `await`**
    - Trong `lib/features/common/splash_screen.dart` đang gọi:
        ```dart
        ref.read(fcmServiceProvider).initialize();
        ```
    - Do không `await`, `try/catch` bên ngoài không bắt được lỗi bất đồng bộ.
    - Bản thân `FcmService` lại nuốt lỗi Firebase và chỉ ghi debug log, nên lỗi gần như không hiển thị.

4. **Signing hiện tại không hỗ trợ push**
    - Bản trên iPhone vừa được ký bằng Personal Team `S6D2577L95`.
    - Personal Team/free provisioning không hỗ trợ entitlement APNs.
    - Muốn test push thật cần dùng Apple Developer Team có Push Notifications capability, ví dụ team chính thức `4G698M9C96`, cùng provisioning profile phù hợp.

### Để hoàn thiện push notification

Cần:

- Firebase project có iOS app bundle ID `com.hubsight.app`.
- Thêm `ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist`.
- Thêm Firebase Android app và `android/app/google-services.json`.
- Bật **Push Notifications** và **Background Modes → Remote notifications** trong Xcode.
- Tạo `Runner.entitlements` có `aps-environment`.
- Upload APNs authentication key `.p8` lên Firebase.
- Sửa lifecycle khởi tạo FCM, xử lý trạng thái denied và đồng bộ lại token sau login/config change.
- Build bằng Apple Developer Team có hỗ trợ APNs, không dùng Personal Team.

Phần UI “Thông báo” hiện tại chủ yếu đang hiển thị danh sách notification lấy từ HubSight backend/relay, **không chứng minh system push đã hoạt động**.

# Các bước cấu hình push notification

## 1. Chuẩn bị Firebase project

Truy cập [Firebase Console](https://console.firebase.google.com/) và tạo hoặc chọn Firebase project của HubSight.

Trong **Project settings → General**, đăng ký hai app:

### iOS app

- Apple bundle ID: `com.quoctran.hubsight`
- App nickname: `HubSight iOS`
- App Store ID: có thể để trống.

Tải:

```text
GoogleService-Info.plist
```

### Android app

- Android package name: `com.quoctran.hubsight`
- App nickname: `HubSight Android`
- SHA-1/SHA-256 có thể thêm sau nếu hiện tại chỉ dùng FCM.

Tải:

```text
google-services.json
```

Bundle ID/package name phải khớp tuyệt đối, kể cả chữ hoa/thường.

---

## 2. Cấu hình bằng FlutterFire CLI

Cài CLI:

```bash
npm install -g firebase-tools
firebase login
dart pub global activate flutterfire_cli
```

Tại thư mục project, chạy:

```bash
flutterfire configure \
  --project=<FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID> \
  --platforms=ios,android \
  --ios-bundle-id=com.quoctran.hubsight \
  --android-package-name=com.quoctran.hubsight \
  --out=lib/firebase_options.dart
```

Thay `<FIREBASE_PROJECT_ID>` bằng ID Firebase thực tế.

Sau khi chạy, cần có:

```text
lib/firebase_options.dart
ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist
android/app/google-services.json
```

Nếu CLI không tự chép hai file native, đặt thủ công:

- `GoogleService-Info.plist` → `ios/Runner/GoogleService-Info.plist`
- `google-services.json` → `android/app/google-services.json`

Với iOS, `GoogleService-Info.plist` còn phải được thêm vào target `Runner`:

1. Mở `ios/Runner.xcworkspace`.
2. Kéo file vào group `Runner`.
3. Chọn **Copy items if needed**.
4. Đánh dấu target membership **Runner**.

---

# 3. Cấu hình Apple Developer và APNs

Push notification trên iPhone thật cần Apple Developer Program có hỗ trợ APNs. **Personal Team/free provisioning không hỗ trợ Push Notifications đầy đủ.**

## Tạo App ID

Truy cập [Apple Developer](https://developer.apple.com/account/):

1. Mở **Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles**.
2. Chọn **Identifiers**.
3. Nhấn `+`.
4. Chọn **App IDs → App**.
5. Chọn Explicit Bundle ID:
    ```text
    com.quoctran.hubsight
    ```
6. Bật capability:
    - **Push Notifications**

## Tạo APNs Authentication Key

1. Vào **Keys**.
2. Nhấn `+`.
3. Đặt tên, ví dụ `HubSight Firebase APNs`.
4. Bật:
    - **Apple Push Notifications service (APNs)**
5. Tạo và tải file `.p8`.
6. Ghi lại:
    - **Key ID**
    - **Team ID**

File `.p8` chỉ tải được một lần.

> Không commit file `.p8` hoặc Firebase Admin service account JSON vào Git.

---

# 4. Upload APNs key lên Firebase

Trong Firebase Console:

1. Mở **Project settings**.
2. Chọn tab **Cloud Messaging**.
3. Tìm phần cấu hình Apple app `com.quoctran.hubsight`.
4. Tại **APNs Authentication Key**, chọn Upload.
5. Upload file `.p8`.
6. Nhập:
    - Key ID
    - Team ID

Một APNs authentication key có thể dùng cho cả development và production.

---

# 5. Bật capability trong Xcode

Mở:

```bash
open ios/Runner.xcworkspace
```

Chọn:

```text
Runner project → Runner target → Signing & Capabilities
```

Thực hiện:

1. Chọn đúng **paid Apple Developer Team**.
2. Kiểm tra bundle ID:
    ```text
    com.quoctran.hubsight
    ```
3. Bật **Automatically manage signing**.
4. Nhấn **+ Capability** và thêm:
    - **Push Notifications**
    - **Background Modes**
5. Trong Background Modes, đánh dấu:
    - **Remote notifications**

Xcode sẽ tạo `Runner.entitlements` với entitlement tương tự:

```xml
<key>aps-environment</key>
<string>development</string>
```

Khi archive bằng distribution profile, giá trị tương ứng sẽ là `production`.

Project hiện đang lưu signing team `4G698M9C96`, nhưng máy trước đó chỉ nhận diện Personal Team `S6D2577L95`. Anh cần đăng nhập tài khoản paid team trong:

```text
Xcode → Settings → Accounts
```

Sau đó chọn đúng paid team tại **Signing & Capabilities**.

---

# 6. Phần Android cần hoàn thiện

Sau khi có `android/app/google-services.json`, cần áp dụng Google Services Gradle plugin.

Trong root Android Gradle/plugin configuration, khai báo plugin `com.google.gms.google-services` theo phiên bản Firebase docs hiện hành; trong `android/app/build.gradle.kts` thêm:

```kotlin
plugins {
    id("com.android.application")
    id("com.google.gms.google-services")
    id("dev.flutter.flutter-gradle-plugin")
}
```

Android 13 trở lên cũng cần permission:

```xml
<uses-permission android:name="android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS"/>
```

đặt trong `android/app/src/main/AndroidManifest.xml`, bên ngoài `<application>`.

Không nên thêm Google Services plugin trước khi có `google-services.json`, vì Android build có thể thất bại do thiếu file cấu hình.

---

# 7. Phần code Flutter còn cần sửa

Sau khi có Firebase config, code app cần được hoàn thiện ở các điểm sau:

1. Khởi tạo Firebase trước `runApp()` bằng `DefaultFirebaseOptions.currentPlatform`.
2. Đăng ký background handler trước `runApp()`.
3. `await` quá trình khởi tạo FCM thay vì fire-and-forget trong splash.
4. Đổi `criticalAlert: true` thành `false`, trừ khi Apple đã cấp entitlement Critical Alerts riêng.
5. Cấu hình hiển thị notification khi app ở foreground:
    ```dart
    FirebaseMessaging.instance.setForegroundNotificationPresentationOptions(
      alert: true,
      badge: true,
      sound: true,
    );
    ```
6. Xử lý notification tap để chuyển tới tab Notifications hoặc đúng camera/event.
7. Đồng bộ token lại khi:
    - Login thành công.
    - Token refresh.
    - Người dùng đổi server config.
8. Unregister token khi logout.
9. Hiển thị trạng thái quyền trong Settings của app:
    - Allowed
    - Denied
    - Not determined
10. Nếu cần banner hệ thống trên Android khi app đang foreground, thêm `flutter_local_notifications` và notification channel.

Code hiện có một phần đăng ký/unregister token, nhưng listener foreground và notification tap chưa được nối với UI.

---

# 8. Backend cần hỗ trợ

Backend HubSight cần:

- Lưu FCM token theo:
    - User
    - Device
    - Platform
    - Server config
- Xóa token khi logout.
- Cập nhật token khi Firebase refresh.
- Gửi notification qua **FCM HTTP v1 API**.
- Dùng Firebase Admin service account chỉ trên server.
- Xóa token nếu FCM trả về `UNREGISTERED` hoặc token invalid.

Không đặt Firebase Admin service-account JSON trong mobile app.

---

# 9. Kiểm tra sau khi hoàn tất

1. Xóa app cũ `com.hubsight.app` nếu không muốn có hai icon HubSight.
2. Build và cài app mới `com.quoctran.hubsight`.
3. Mở app lần đầu.
4. iOS phải hiển thị hộp thoại xin quyền thông báo.
5. Sau khi đồng ý, HubSight sẽ xuất hiện tại:
    ```text
    Settings → Notifications → HubSight
    ```
6. Dùng FCM registration token gửi test message từ Firebase Console.
7. Kiểm tra ba trạng thái:
    - App foreground.
    - App background.
    - App bị terminate.
8. Kiểm tra tap notification mở đúng màn hình.

Nếu từng nhấn **Don’t Allow**, iOS sẽ không hiện prompt lần hai; cần bật lại trong Settings hoặc xóa/cài lại app trong giai đoạn test.

Khi anh đã tạo Firebase app, hãy đặt hai file `GoogleService-Info.plist` và `google-services.json` vào project. Sau đó tôi có thể hoàn thiện toàn bộ phần code, entitlements, Gradle và build lại lên iPhone.

# Get started with Firebase Cloud Messaging in Flutter apps Stay organized with collections Save and categorize content based on your preferences.

    | **Select platform:**     |       iOS+      Android      Web      Flutter      Unity      C++       |

This guide describes how to get started with Firebase Cloud Messaging in your Flutter client apps so that you can reliably send messages.

Depending on the platform you're targeting, there are some additional required setup steps that you'll need to take.

## iOS+

### Enable app capabilities in XCode

Before your application can start to receive messages, you must enable push notifications and background modes in your Xcode project.

- Open your Xcode project workspace (`ios/Runner.xcworkspace`).
- Enable push notifications.
- Enable the Background fetch and the Remote notifications background execution modes.

### Upload your APNs authentication key

Before you use FCM, upload your APNs authentication key to Firebase. If you don't already have an APNs authentication key, create one in the Apple Developer Member Center.

-     In the Firebase console, go to     settings Settings >     General. Then, click the     Cloud Messaging tab.
-     In APNs authentication key under iOS app configuration,     click Upload to upload your development authentication key, or     production authentication key, or both. At least one is required.
-     For each authentication key, select the `.p8` file, and provide     the key ID and your Apple team ID. Click Save.

#### Method swizzling

To use the FCM Flutter plugin on Apple devices, method swizzling is required. Without it, key Firebase features such as FCM token handling won't function properly.

## Android

### Google Play services

FCM clients require devices running Android 4.4 or higher that also have Google Play services installed, or an emulator running Android 4.4 with Google APIs. Note that you are not limited to deploying your Android apps through Google Play Store.

Apps that rely on the Play Services SDK should always check the device for a compatible Google Play services APK before accessing Google Play services features. It is recommended to do this in two places: in the main activity's `onCreate()` method, and in its `onResume()` method. The check in `onCreate()`makes sure that the app can't be used without a successful check. The check in `onResume()` makes sure that if the user returns to the running app through some other means, such as through the back button, the check is still performed.

If the device doesn't have a compatible version of Google Play services, your app can call `GoogleApiAvailability.makeGooglePlayServicesAvailable()`to allow users to download Google Play services from the Play Store.

## Web

### Configure Web Credentials with FCM

The FCM Web interface uses Web credentials called Voluntary Application Server Identification, or "VAPID" keys, to authorize send requests to supported web push services. To subscribe your app to push notifications, you need to associate a pair of keys with your Firebase project. You can either generate a new key pair or import your existing key pair through the Firebase console.

### Generate a new key pair

-

In the Firebase console, go to settings **Settings** > **General**. Then, click the **Cloud Messaging** tab.
-

Go to the **Web configuration** section.
-

In the **Web Push certificates** tab, click **Generate Key Pair**.

The console displays a notice that the key pair was generated, and it displays the public key string and date added.

### Import an existing key pair

If you have an existing key pair you are already using with your web app, you can import it to FCM so that you can reach your existing web app instances through FCM APIs. To import keys, you must have owner-level access to the Firebase project. Import your existing public and private key in base64 URL safe encoded form:
-

In the Firebase console, go to settings **Settings** > **General**. Then, click the **Cloud Messaging** tab.
-

Go to the **Web configuration** section.
-

In the **Web Push certificates** tab, select **import an existing key pair**.
-

In the **Import a key pair** dialog, provide your public and private keys in the corresponding fields and click **Import**.

The console displays the public key string and date added.

For more information about the format of the keys and how to generate them, see Application server keys.

## Install the FCM plugin

-

Install and initialize the Firebase plugins for Flutterif you haven't already done so.
-

From the root of your Flutter project, run the following command to install the plugin:

```
flutter pub add firebase_messaging

```

-

Once complete, rebuild your Flutter application:

```
flutter run

```

## Access the registration token

To send a message to a specific device, you need to know the device registration token. To retrieve the registration token for an app instance, call `getToken()`. If notification permission has not been granted, this method will ask the user for notification permissions. Otherwise, it returns a token or rejects the future due to an error.**Warning:** In iOS SDK 10.4.0 and higher, it is required that the APNs token is available before making API requests. The APNs token is not guaranteed to have been received before making FCM plugin API requests.

```
// You may set the permission requests to "provisional" which allows the user to choose what type
// of notifications they would like to receive once the user receives a notification.
final notificationSettings = await FirebaseMessaging.instance.requestPermission(provisional: true);

// For apple platforms, make sure the APNS token is available before making any FCM plugin API calls
final apnsToken = await FirebaseMessaging.instance.getAPNSToken();
if (apnsToken != null) {
 // APNS token is available, make FCM plugin API requests...
}

```

On web platforms, pass your VAPID public key to `getToken()`:

```
final fcmToken = await FirebaseMessaging.instance.getToken(vapidKey: "BKagOny0KF_2pCJQ3m....moL0ewzQ8rZu");

```

To be notified whenever the token is updated, subscribe to the `onTokenRefresh`stream:

```
FirebaseMessaging.instance.onTokenRefresh
    .listen((fcmToken) {
      // TODO: If necessary send token to application server.

      // Note: This callback is fired at each app startup and whenever a new
      // token is generated.
    })
    .onError((err) {
      // Error getting token.
    });

```

## Prevent auto initialization

When an FCM registration token is generated, the library uploads the identifier and configuration data to Firebase. If you prefer to prevent token auto generation, disable auto-initialization at build time.

### iOS

On iOS, add a metadata value to your `Info.plist`:

```
FirebaseMessagingAutoInitEnabled = NO

```

### Android

On Android, disable Analytics collection and FCM auto initialization (you must disable both) by adding these metadata values to your `AndroidManifest.xml`:

```
<meta-data
    android:name="firebase_messaging_auto_init_enabled"
    android:value="false" />
<meta-data
    android:name="firebase_analytics_collection_enabled"
    android:value="false" />

```

### Re-enable FCM auto-init at runtime

To enable auto-init for a specific app instance, call `setAutoInitEnabled()`:

```
await FirebaseMessaging.instance.setAutoInitEnabled(true);

```

This value persists across app restarts once set.

## Send a test notification message

-

Install and run the app on the target device. On Apple devices, you'll need to accept the request for permission to receive remote notifications.
-

Make sure the app is in the background on the device.
-

In the Firebase console, go to **DevOps & Engagement** > **Messaging**.
-

Create a campaign.
-

If this is your first message:
-

Select **Create your first campaign**.
-

Select **Firebase Notification messages** and select **Create**.

-

If you have previously created campaigns:
-

On the **Campaigns** tab, select **New campaign**.
-

Click **Notifications**.

-

Enter the message text.
-

Select **Send test message** from the right pane.
-

In the field labeled **Add an FCM registration token**, enter your registration token.
-

Select **Test**.

After you select **Test**, the targeted client device, with the app in the background, should receive the notification.

For insight into message delivery to your app, go to the **DevOps & Engagement** > **Messaging** > **Reports** dashboard in the Firebase console. This dashboard records the number of messages sent and opened on Apple and Android devices, along with data for "impressions" (notifications seen by users) for Android apps.

## Handling interaction

When users tap a notification, the default behavior on both Android and iOS is to open the application. If the application is terminated, it will be started, and if it is in the background, it will be brought to the foreground.

Depending on the content of a notification, you may want to handle the user's interaction when the application opens. For example, if a new chat message is sent using a notification and the user selects it, you may want to open the specific conversation when the application opens.

The `firebase-messaging` package provides two ways to handle this interaction:

- `getInitialMessage():` If the application is opened from a terminated state, this method returns a `Future` containing a `RemoteMessage`. Once consumed, the `RemoteMessage` will be removed.
- `onMessageOpenedApp`: A`Stream` which posts a `RemoteMessage` when the application is opened from a background state.

To make sure your users have a smooth experience, you should handle both scenarios. The following code example outlines how this can be achieved:

```
class Application extends StatefulWidget {
  @override
  State createState() => _Application();
}

class _Application extends State {
  // In this example, suppose that all messages contain a data field with the key 'type'.
  Future setupInteractedMessage() async {
    // Get any messages which caused the application to open from
    // a terminated state.
    RemoteMessage? initialMessage =
        await FirebaseMessaging.instance.getInitialMessage();

    // If the message also contains a data property with a "type" of "chat",
    // navigate to a chat screen
    if (initialMessage != null) {
      _handleMessage(initialMessage);
    }

    // Also handle any interaction when the app is in the background using a
    // Stream listener
    FirebaseMessaging.onMessageOpenedApp.listen(_handleMessage);
  }

  void _handleMessage(RemoteMessage message) {
    if (message.data['type'] == 'chat') {
      Navigator.pushNamed(context, '/chat',
        arguments: ChatArguments(message),
      );
    }
  }

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    // Run code required to handle interacted messages in an async function
    // as initState() must not be async
    setupInteractedMessage();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Text("...");
  }
}
```

How you handle interaction depends on your setup. The previously shown example is a basic example of using a `StatefulWidget`.

## Next steps

After you have completed the setup steps, here are a few options for moving forward with FCM for Flutter:

- Send messages to devices
- Receive messages in a Flutter app
- Send messages to topics

Đúng, nếu thiết kế của HubSight là **FCM config được nhận động từ `.hscfg`**, thì không bắt buộc phải có:

- `GoogleService-Info.plist`
- `google-services.json`
- `firebase_options.dart`

Tôi đính chính phần hướng dẫn trước: các file đó chỉ cần khi dùng Firebase config cố định lúc build. Với HubSight, ta có thể khởi tạo Firebase bằng `FirebaseOptions` tại runtime.

## Tuy nhiên code hiện tại chưa làm đúng kiến trúc này

Trong `lib/core/services/fcm_service.dart`, app đang gọi:

```dart
await Firebase.initializeApp();
```

mà không truyền `FirebaseOptions`.

Đồng thời, `lib/features/common/splash_screen.dart` đang khởi tạo FCM **trước khi** restore cấu hình HubSight:

```dart
ref.read(fcmServiceProvider).initialize();
```

Do không có Firebase config cố định, lệnh này sẽ thất bại trước khi xin quyền notification. Luồng đúng phải là:

```text
Restore/import .hscfg
        ↓
Đọc Firebase config từ .hscfg
        ↓
Firebase.initializeApp(options: ...)
        ↓
Xin quyền notification
        ↓
Chờ APNs token trên iOS
        ↓
Lấy FCM token
        ↓
Đăng ký token với HubSight backend
```

## Dữ liệu `.hscfg` cần chứa

Firebase App ID khác nhau giữa iOS và Android, nên config nên có tối thiểu:

```json
{
    "firebase": {
        "projectId": "hubsight-production",
        "messagingSenderId": "1234567890",
        "apiKey": "...",
        "iosAppId": "1:1234567890:ios:...",
        "androidAppId": "1:1234567890:android:...",
        "storageBucket": "hubsight-production.firebasestorage.app"
    }
}
```

Sau đó Flutter khởi tạo:

```dart
final options = FirebaseOptions(
  apiKey: config.firebase.apiKey,
  appId: Platform.isIOS
      ? config.firebase.iosAppId
      : config.firebase.androidAppId,
  messagingSenderId: config.firebase.messagingSenderId,
  projectId: config.firebase.projectId,
  storageBucket: config.firebase.storageBucket,
);

await Firebase.initializeApp(options: options);
```

Các giá trị Firebase client config này không phải admin secret. Tuy nhiên `.hscfg` vẫn phải được xác thực chữ ký vì một config giả có thể chuyển app sang Firebase project do bên khác kiểm soát.

## Khi thay đổi server config

Nếu người dùng import một `.hscfg` thuộc Firebase project khác, nên thực hiện:

1. Unregister FCM token khỏi backend cũ.
2. Gọi `FirebaseMessaging.instance.deleteToken()`.
3. Đóng các FCM listener cũ.
4. Xóa/reinitialize Firebase app.
5. Tạo FCM token cho Firebase project mới.
6. Đăng ký token với backend mới.

Trong thực tế, với FlutterFire và background messaging, phương án an toàn nhất sau khi đổi config là **khởi động lại app process** rồi initialize Firebase từ config mới đã lưu.

Background handler cũng phải đọc được Firebase config đã persist mà không cần người dùng nhập lại passcode. Nếu config chỉ giải mã được bằng thao tác người dùng, notification dạng `data-only` khi app bị terminate sẽ không khởi tạo được Dart handler. Notification có payload `notification` vẫn có thể được iOS hiển thị trực tiếp.

# Có cần mua Apple Developer Account không?

## Nếu cần remote push notification trên iPhone: Có

Chuỗi gửi push trên iOS là:

```text
HubSight backend → FCM → APNs → iPhone
```

Firebase không thay thế APNs. FCM vẫn phải chuyển notification qua hệ thống Apple Push Notification service.

Để app có entitlement:

```xml
<key>aps-environment</key>
<string>development</string>
```

anh cần provisioning profile của một team thuộc:

- Apple Developer Program, hoặc
- Apple Developer Enterprise Program.

**Personal Team/free provisioning không hỗ trợ remote Push Notifications đầy đủ.**

Apple Developer Program thông thường có giá khoảng **99 USD/năm**, tùy quốc gia và thuế. Một số tổ chức giáo dục, phi lợi nhuận hoặc cơ quan nhà nước có thể đủ điều kiện miễn phí.

Tài liệu chính thức của Apple: [Supported capabilities (iOS)](https://developer.apple.com/help/account/reference/supported-capabilities-ios/)

## Không nhất thiết chính anh phải mua

Anh có ba lựa chọn:

1. Đăng ký Apple Developer Program cá nhân.
2. Dùng tài khoản Organization của HubSight.
3. Được mời vào một Apple Developer paid team hiện có.

Chỉ cần app được ký bằng paid team có quyền tạo App ID, APNs key và provisioning profile. Người build cần được cấp quyền phù hợp trong team đó.

## Nếu không mua thì làm được gì?

Với Personal Team hiện tại:

- Cài app trực tiếp lên iPhone để test UI: được.
- Local notification do chính app tạo: được.
- Xin quyền local notification: được.
- Android FCM push: được, không liên quan Apple.
- Remote FCM/APNs push trên iOS: không dùng được ổn định.
- TestFlight/App Store: không được.
- Bản cài Personal Team thường có provisioning thời hạn ngắn.

Vì vậy có thể implement và test Android FCM trước, nhưng muốn xác nhận push thật trên iPhone thì cần paid team.

# Việc cần làm trên Apple Developer sau khi có paid account

## 1. Đăng ký App ID

Trong **Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles → Identifiers**:

- Type: App
- Explicit bundle ID:
    ```text
    com.quoctran.hubsight
    ```
- Enable:
    - Push Notifications
    - Background Modes nếu portal cho cấu hình tại đây.

## 2. Tạo APNs Authentication Key

Trong **Keys**:

1. Tạo key mới.
2. Bật **Apple Push Notifications service (APNs)**.
3. Tải file `.p8`.
4. Ghi lại:
    - Key ID
    - Team ID.

Không commit `.p8` vào Git.

## 3. Upload APNs key vào các Firebase project

Mỗi Firebase project có thể được tham chiếu bởi `.hscfg` phải có:

- iOS Firebase app với bundle ID:
    ```text
    com.quoctran.hubsight
    ```
- APNs authentication key đã upload.
- Key ID và Apple Team ID đúng.

Điểm quan trọng: nếu HubSight hỗ trợ nhiều server, mỗi server sử dụng một Firebase project riêng thì **tất cả Firebase project đó** đều phải:

1. Đăng ký iOS app `com.quoctran.hubsight`.
2. Đăng ký Android app `com.quoctran.hubsight`.
3. Có APNs key phù hợp.
4. Sinh Firebase client options để đưa vào `.hscfg`.

Một APNs `.p8` key của cùng Apple Team có thể được dùng cho nhiều Firebase project.

## 4. Bật capability trong Xcode

Mở:

```bash
open ios/Runner.xcworkspace
```

Trong `Runner → Signing & Capabilities`:

- Chọn paid Apple Developer Team.
- Bundle ID: `com.quoctran.hubsight`.
- Bật **Automatically manage signing**.
- Thêm:
    - **Push Notifications**
    - **Background Modes**
- Trong Background Modes bật:
    - **Remote notifications**
    - Firebase hiện cũng hướng dẫn bật **Background fetch**.

Xcode sẽ tạo `Runner.entitlements` và provisioning profile có `aps-environment`.

# Phần code tôi cần sửa tiếp

Sau khi xác nhận schema Firebase trong `.hscfg`, tôi sẽ cần:

1. Mở rộng model config để chứa Firebase runtime options nếu chưa có.
2. Đảo thứ tự splash: restore HSCFG trước, initialize Firebase sau.
3. Khởi tạo `FirebaseApp` từ config động.
4. Persist Firebase options cần thiết cho background isolate.
5. Đăng ký background handler trước khi nhận message.
6. Xin quyền notification sau khi Firebase được khởi tạo.
7. Không request `criticalAlert: true` vì capability này cần Apple entitlement đặc biệt.
8. Chờ `getAPNSToken()` trước khi gọi `getToken()` trên iOS.
9. Hiển thị notification trong foreground.
10. Điều hướng tới đúng camera/event khi người dùng tap notification.
11. Xử lý token refresh, login, logout và đổi server config.
12. Thêm `POST_NOTIFICATIONS` cho Android 13+.
13. Xóa token của Firebase project cũ trước khi chuyển config.

Tài liệu Firebase chính thức cũng xác nhận iOS cần bật Push Notifications, Background Modes và upload APNs key: [Firebase Cloud Messaging for Flutter](https://firebase.google.com/docs/cloud-messaging/flutter/client).

Tóm lại: **Firebase config động từ `.hscfg` là khả thi và phù hợp kiến trúc multi-server, nhưng iOS remote push vẫn bắt buộc app được ký bằng một paid Apple Developer Team có APNs capability.**

import 'dart:async';
import '../network/api_client.dart';
import '../network/endpoints.dart';
import '../security/device_info_collector.dart';
import '../security/secure_storage.dart';
import 'models/auth_response.dart';
import 'models/passkey_item.dart';
import 'models/session_item.dart';
import 'models/user_profile.dart';

/// Manager for authentication lifecycle, session tracking, and user profile.
class HubSightAuthManager {
  final HubSightApiClient _client;
  final HubSightSecureStorage _storage;
  final DeviceInfoCollector _deviceCollector;

  UserProfile? _currentUser;
  final StreamController<UserProfile?> _userStreamController =
      StreamController<UserProfile?>.broadcast();

  HubSightAuthManager({
    required HubSightApiClient client,
    required HubSightSecureStorage storage,
    DeviceInfoCollector? deviceCollector,
  })  : _client = client,
        _storage = storage,
        _deviceCollector = deviceCollector ?? DeviceInfoCollector();

  Stream<UserProfile?> get onUserChanged => _userStreamController.stream;
  UserProfile? get currentUser => _currentUser;

  /// Check if user has an active session in local storage.
  Future<bool> get isAuthenticated async {
    final token = await _storage.getAccessToken();
    return token != null && token.isNotEmpty;
  }

  /// Primary login with username, password, optional geolocation, and automatic device fingerprinting.
  Future<AuthResult> login({
    required String username,
    required String password,
    double? latitude,
    double? longitude,
    double? accuracy,
    String? geoCity,
    String? geoCountry,
    String? geoRegion,
  }) async {
    final device = await _deviceCollector.collect(
      latitude: latitude,
      longitude: longitude,
      accuracy: accuracy,
      geoCity: geoCity,
      geoCountry: geoCountry,
      geoRegion: geoRegion,
    );

    final payload = {
      'username': username,
      'password': password,
      'device_name': device.deviceLabel,
      'platform': device.clientType,
      'device_id': device.fingerprint,
      'device_info': device.toMap(),
    };

    final data = await _client.post(Endpoints.authLogin, data: payload);
    final result = AuthResult.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(data as Map));

    if (result.isSuccess && result.accessToken != null) {
      await _storage.saveTokens(
        accessToken: result.accessToken!,
        refreshToken: result.refreshToken,
      );
      _currentUser = result.user;
      _userStreamController.add(_currentUser);
    }

    return result;
  }

  /// Verify TOTP code or recovery code during two-factor authentication challenge.
  Future<AuthResult> verify2FA({
    required String preAuthToken,
    required String code,
    String? recoveryCode,
    double? latitude,
    double? longitude,
    double? accuracy,
    String? geoCity,
    String? geoCountry,
    String? geoRegion,
  }) async {
    final device = await _deviceCollector.collect(
      latitude: latitude,
      longitude: longitude,
      accuracy: accuracy,
      geoCity: geoCity,
      geoCountry: geoCountry,
      geoRegion: geoRegion,
    );

    final payload = {
      'pre_auth_token': preAuthToken,
      'code': code,
      if (recoveryCode != null && recoveryCode.isNotEmpty)
        'recovery_code': recoveryCode,
      'device_info': device.toMap(),
    };

    final data = await _client.post(Endpoints.auth2faVerify, data: payload);
    final result = AuthResult.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(data as Map));

    if (result.isSuccess && result.accessToken != null) {
      await _storage.saveTokens(
        accessToken: result.accessToken!,
        refreshToken: result.refreshToken,
      );
      _currentUser = result.user;
      _userStreamController.add(_currentUser);
    }

    return result;
  }

  /// Manually refresh access token using current refresh token.
  Future<bool> refreshToken() async {
    final refreshToken = await _storage.getRefreshToken();
    if (refreshToken == null || refreshToken.isEmpty) return false;

    final data = await _client.post(
      Endpoints.authRefresh,
      data: {'refresh_token': refreshToken},
    );

    final resMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data as Map);
    final newAccess = (resMap['access_token'] ?? resMap['token']) as String?;
    final newRefresh = resMap['refresh_token'] as String?;

    if (newAccess != null && newAccess.isNotEmpty) {
      await _storage.saveTokens(
        accessToken: newAccess,
        refreshToken: newRefresh ?? refreshToken,
      );
      return true;
    }
    return false;
  }

  /// Change account password.
  Future<void> changePassword({
    required String currentPassword,
    required String newPassword,
  }) async {
    await _client.post(
      Endpoints.authChangePassword,
      data: {
        'current_password': currentPassword,
        'new_password': newPassword,
      },
    );
  }

  /// Sign out current session and clear stored tokens.
  Future<void> logout() async {
    try {
      await _client.post(Endpoints.authLogout);
    } catch (_) {
      // Best effort remote revocation
    } finally {
      await _storage.clearTokens();
      _currentUser = null;
      _userStreamController.add(null);
    }
  }

  /// Fetch full user profile and permissions from server.
  Future<UserProfile> getProfile() async {
    final data = await _client.get(Endpoints.profile);
    _currentUser = UserProfile.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(data as Map));
    _userStreamController.add(_currentUser);
    return _currentUser!;
  }

  /// Update profile preferences (full name, locale, timezone, theme, push preferences).
  Future<UserProfile> updateProfile({
    String? fullName,
    String? locale,
    String? timezone,
    String? theme,
    Map<String, bool>? pushPreferences,
  }) async {
    final payload = <String, dynamic>{
      if (fullName != null) 'full_name': fullName,
      if (locale != null) 'locale': locale,
      if (timezone != null) 'timezone': timezone,
      if (theme != null) 'theme': theme,
      if (pushPreferences != null) 'push_preferences': pushPreferences,
    };

    final data = await _client.patch(Endpoints.profile, data: payload);
    final userMap = (data as Map)['user'] as Map<String, dynamic>? ??
        Map<String, dynamic>.from(data);
    _currentUser = UserProfile.fromJson(userMap);
    _userStreamController.add(_currentUser);
    return _currentUser!;
  }

  /// List active sessions across all devices for this account.
  Future<List<SessionItem>> listSessions() async {
    final data = await _client.get(Endpoints.profileSessions);
    final list = (data as Map)['sessions'] as List? ?? [];
    return list
        .map((e) => SessionItem.fromJson(Map<String, dynamic>.from(e as Map)))
        .toList();
  }

  /// Remotely revoke a specific session.
  Future<void> revokeSession(String sessionId) async {
    await _client.delete(Endpoints.profileSessionRevoke(sessionId));
  }

  // ── Passkey / FIDO2 (WebAuthn) ─────────────────────────────────────────────

  /// Fetch list of registered passkey credentials for current user.
  Future<List<PasskeyItem>> listPasskeys() async {

    required String credential,

      'credential': credential,
      'is_pwa': false,
      'device_info': customDeviceInfo ?? device.toMap(),
    };

    final data =

    if (result.isSuccess && result.accessToken != null) {
      await _storage.saveTokens(
        accessToken: result.accessToken!,
        refreshToken: result.refreshToken,
      );
      _currentUser = result.user;
      _userStreamController.add(_currentUser);
    }

    return result;
  }

    required String credential,

  }) async {

      Endpoints.authPasskeyRegisterVerify,
      data: {
        'challenge_id': challengeId,
        'credential': credential,
        'name': name,
      },
    );
    final resMap = Map<String, dynamic>.from(data as Map);
    final passkeyMap = resMap['passkey'] != null
        ? Map<String, dynamic>.from(resMap['passkey'] as Map)
        : resMap;
    return PasskeyItem.fromJson(passkeyMap);
  }

  /// Rename a registered passkey.
  Future<void> renamePasskey(String id, String name) async {

  Future<void> deletePasskey(String id) async {
